notes.title: Celebrate the New Year: Special Sale and New Features Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/9f32cdc4e1d29d3d7192a0fb13b93a8c718d3f7b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/83e8ef728ceedfa5d666bfbff132e662a0cf124e.jpg
Dear Players,  

The Lunar New Year is just around the corner! After a long review process, the trading cards for Nebel and the corresponding community rewards are finally live. To celebrate this occasion, we’re also putting Nebel and 5 Days Mischief Game on sale! Here are the details:  

1. Trading Cards for *Nebel Geisterjäger* Are Now Available!  
   This is our first attempt at trading cards. The artist and I worked hard to meet Steam’s requirements while balancing player preferences, revising the designs multiple times. We hope you enjoy them!  

2. Full Support for Traditional Chinese  
   Although this announcement is a bit late, we’re excited to share that all of our games now fully support Traditional Chinese. We hope you’ll give them a try!  

3. Steam Cloud Save Support  
   To help you continue your game progress anytime, anywhere, all of our games now support Steam Cloud Save. We hope you enjoy this new feature!  

Thank you for your continued support and love for our games. We wish you a joyful and rewarding Lunar New Year! Be sure to check out our store pages and don’t miss the upcoming sale!  

Happy New Year!  
From the Development Team

notes.title: Tunnel Escape Releasing on August 23rd!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/5188ccdfb6c367edc704ff6071718eed0a7d9d07.png

Hello everyone!

We have some exciting news to share! Tunnel Escape will be available on

23rd August 2024 (-UTC 4)! 

Try the Demo and wishlist the game now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908950/Tunnel_Escape/

Embark on a journey to save humankind as you kick, shoot, and loot your way out of a secret underground laboratory in this rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV. 

Tunnel Escape combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system with hundreds of active and passive abilities. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown and each step taken will count towards failure or success.

Elzee and our team are working hard to deliver you the full experience as soon as possible, up until then we hope that you’ll enjoy your time in the demo version. Feedback is very welcome, please let us know your thoughts or any issues that you should encounter in the demo. You can reach out to us here on Steam, in the Saikey Steam Community, on our social channels, and Discord.

notes.title: Announcement Regarding Game Abnormalities After the Update
notes.content: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience we have caused. Previously, in the Steam version of the game, there were issues where missing audio files led to errors(This issue only affects users who are using the original Steam version of the game), so we pushed a minor update today. However, we have discovered that for users who have installed the complete version, updating through Steam overwrites the existing "normal game content," reverting the game back to the Steam version. We deeply regret this issue. If you have already updated the game, you can fix it by re-overwriting with the complete version game files. Please note that this Steam update will not affect your save data, so there's no need to worry. In the future, we will be more cautious with related updates to avoid such inconvenience (no further updates are planned).
